title: Brick College Campus Building, Shaded Lawn - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square snapshot with a deckled edge showing a sun-dappled lawn and towering shade trees leading to a large multi-story brick academic or institutional hall, typical of a mid-20th-century American college or university campus. In the distance to the right, two small figures stroll beneath the foliage. The right border is process-stamped '· JUL · 57', reflecting the peaceful, languid atmosphere of summer school or campus recess in 1957.
